seo.title: Kitchen sink
seo.description: Every part of the default theme in the context of a page: the edge cases a real site runs into sooner or later.

values.heading: Kitchen sink
values.body:
The pages under this one show the default theme at its edges: long words, dark blocks in the main column, blocks side by side on a narrow screen.
They come with the demo and go with php artisan webx:demo --remove — a real site never has them.

seo.title: Long words
seo.description: Words longer than a phone is wide, in the languages that have them.

values.heading: Donaudampfschifffahrtsgesellschaftskapitänsmützenabzeichen
values.body: German glues nouns together: Rindfleischetikettierungsüberwachungsaufgabenübertragungsgesetz was a real law, and a heading like the one above has to break inside the word rather than push the page sideways.

values.heading: Konstantynopolitańczykowianeczka
values.body: Polish brings its own letters and its own lengths: najprawdopodobniej, dziewięćdziesięciokilkuletni, współpracowniczka. Ąą Ćć Ęę Łł Ńń Óó Śś Źź Żż — every one of them in the font the theme names.

values.heading: Превысокомногорассмотрительствующий
values.body:
Cyrillic, which a site with Russian among its languages prints on every page: человеконенавистничество, высокопревосходительство.
An address with no place to break: https://example.com/a/very/long/path/that/goes/on/and/on/without/a/single/space/in/it/anywhere

seo.title: Blocks in the column
seo.description: A dark block, text and columns one after another in the main column of the page.

values.title: A dark block in the main column
values.subtitle: The prose of the theme reaches every block inside the page, so its colours must not assume a light background: this heading and this line stay readable on navy.

values.heading: Text right after it
values.body: The column and the blocks share one left edge, and nothing on this page scrolls sideways at 360 pixels.

values.heading: One
values.body: Three columns on a wide screen, one under another on a phone.

values.heading: Two
values.body: A column with a longer text in it, so that the three are not the same height and the grid has to say what it does about that.
